metadata.title: The Coulhon--Duong conjecture for the Riesz transform on complete Riemannian manifolds
metadata.abstract: Let $M$ be a complete, non-compact Riemannian manifold. We prove that its Riesz transform is of weak type $(1,1)$, with constant $2$ for real-valued functions. Consequently, it is bounded on $L^p(M)$ for $1<p\leq2$, with constants depending only on $p$, which proves the Coulhon--Duong conjecture. The proof uses an obstacle decomposition for positive self-adjoint operators with sub-Markovian semigroups. Applying this decomposition to the shifted square-root Laplacian and using locality of the Sobolev differential yields the endpoint estimate without geometric or heat kernel assumptions. We also obtain the corresponding result for Dirichlet spaces admitting a local Hilbertian differential calculus.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 作者构造正自伴次 Markov 算子的障碍分解，将函数写成有界好项与算子作用于小支撑势的和；应用到带正移位的平方根 Laplace 算子，利用 Sobolev 微分局部性和 L² 收缩获得弱型常数二，再去移位并插值。
analysis.breakthrough: 若论证成立，将无需几何或热核假设地解决 Coulhon–Duong 猜想。
analysis.limitations: 已读 PDF 第 1–7 页主定理、抽象障碍分解及其证明，尚未完成后续端点延拓与一般 Dirichlet 空间论证的独立核验。常数二针对实值端点，1<p≤2 结论也允许复值。AI 披露另见独立核查。
